hypotheses.reasoning: notif-db's /var/lib/mysql volume filled up. Disk usage hit 95% at 22:24:13 (#1252) with WAL/binlog growing 440MB/h, then 99% at 22:28:00 (#2153) with growth accelerating to 726MB/h. InnoDB began failing writes with 'No space left on device' at 22:29:51 (#2622). notification-svc then failed inserts with 'table is full' / ER_RECORD_FILE_FULL (#2758, #3267, #2949), and api-gateway's POST /v1/notify 500s are the downstream symptom of those failures (not cited as cause). The earlier 2026-11-12 index migration completed cleanly at 22:20:03 (#253) and is not the trigger. WAL/binlog growth with nothing purging it is the likely reason the disk filled.

verdict.recommendedAction: Immediately free disk on notif-db: purge old binlogs/WAL (or expand the volume) and confirm /var/lib/mysql is below threshold, then verify notification writes succeed. Afterwards, fix binlog/WAL retention and add disk alerting at 80%; the 95% and 99% warnings came about 5 minutes before failures began. Separately, account-svc /login 502s come from auth-svc POST /tokens responses missing the 'status' field (#3420, #3514, #3734, #3818). That is outside this notify alert and needs its own ticket.
